prompt.project_info: Create a high-fashion portrait in a bright white architectural studio with a dramatic golden faux-fur coat.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional platinum-blonde woman with shoulder-length waves, natural minimal makeup and confident neutral gaze, seated in a comfortable knees-together crouch, oversized golden-yellow shaggy faux-fur coat draped around and covering the body, white ankle-strap heels.
prompt.composition_elements: 3:4 low-angle shot looking upward, white walls, ceiling beams, full silhouette, luxury texture contrast between fur, skin and shoes.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused studio lighting, even professional illumination, clean highlights and minimal shadows, modern commanding mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic high-fashion photography, sharp fur and skin texture, realistic anatomy, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-realistic 3:4 high-fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional platinum-blonde woman with shoulder-length waves, natural minimal makeup and confident neutral gaze, seated comfortably in a knees-together crouch, oversized golden-yellow shaggy faux-fur coat covering the body, white ankle-strap heels, bright architectural white studio, low-angle perspective, soft diffused lighting, luxurious realistic texture, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, exposed intimate areas, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, real fur, plastic skin, over-smooth, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: golden fur haute couture reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve faux-fur coat, white heels, knees-together pose, architecture and low-angle view; identity and micro-details replaceable.
